Carmen (Sales): quick question — Acme Health legal/infosec wants audit logs + proof of key rotation during the POC. They want a sample log schema and retention policy. Is this doable for a hosted-key POC or do we need Dedicated/VPC?

Ben (Solutions Eng): short answer: doable both ways but with different guarantees. For hosted API keys we can provide request-level audit logs + delivery to customer's SIEM via S3/HTTPS subscription. Retention defaults to 30 days for POC but we can extend for dedicated/private.

Elaine (Security): @Carmen can you paste the specific questionnaire snippets? common asks: key rotation proof, KMS usage, logs include actor, request_id, model, timestamp, and redaction guidance for PII.

Carmen (Sales): copied from their doc: "Provide sample audit logs showing request id, timestamp, API key id (rotatable), model invoked, token usage, and confirm logs are encrypted at rest and transit." also they want an attestation email for POC timeframe.

Raj (Platform): tagging technical bits — for hosted POC we issue scoped API keys (api_key_id). We can rotate keys and show rotation events in logs. We also support exporting logs using our log-exporter to an S3 bucket or pushing to a Splunk HEC endpoint.

Ben (Solutions Eng): below is a sample minimal log payload we can provide (we'll redact prompt content by default for PHI):

```
{"timestamp":"2025-11-02T15:03:12Z","request_id":"req_01Gx...","api_key_id":"key_poc_abc123","model":"redwood-3b","user_bucket_id":"acme-poc","tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":128,"status":"200","region":"us-west-2"}
```

Elaine (Security): important: for healthcare PII/PHI customers we recommend Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed S3 and KMS. Hosted can be used if they accept our SOC2 controls and we agree on data handling. Also we can provide a short control matrix for the questionnaire.

Carmen (Sales): they specifically asked "can we demonstrate key rotation during the POC?" — they want to see one rotated key and the old one invalidated, plus the log entry showing rotation event.

Raj (Platform): yes — we can do a live rotation demo for hosted keys. Rotation event shows up in the audit stream as `key.rotate` with fields: old_key_id, new_key_id, actor. We can create a temporary rotation and capture it to export. Example event:

```
{"timestamp":"2025-11-02T15:12:05Z","event":"key.rotate","old_key_id":"key_poc_abc123","new_key_id":"key_poc_def456","actor":"svc-poc-admin"}
```

Ben (Solutions Eng): notes on retention/pricing: extending retention beyond 30 days for POC incurs storage cost (passed-through). If they want 90 days for compliance proof we can set export to their S3 and let them manage lifecycle. Dedicated pools include longer retention options and dedicated log buckets.

Elaine (Security): deliverables we can ship for the questionnaire: 1) sample log file (sanitized) 2) rotation proof (screenshot + exported audit entry) 3) short attestation on encryption + SOC2 scope 4) architecture diagram for Private/VPC option. I can draft the attestation.

Carmen (Sales): amazing — timeline? they want this within the POC week (next Tue). realistic?

Raj (Platform): timeline: hosted demo + log export to customer S3 can be done same-day if they provide an S3 write role/credentials. Dedicated env provisioning takes ~3 business days (request -> reserve GPU pool -> network).

Ben (Solutions Eng): action items: Carmen collect S3 details + questionnaire snippets. I'll prepare sanitized sample logs and a short runbook for rotation demo. Elaine will draft attestation. Raj will stand by for export onboarding.

Elaine (Security): +1. Carmen, also have them sign a minimal DPA addendum for POC if PHI is involved.

Carmen (Sales): ok will ping the customer for S3 role and the exact Qs. thanks all :pray: 

DeployBot: scheduled: poc-logging-export job queued for capture window 2025-11-03T00:00Z -> 2025-11-07T00:00Z (id: job_992f).

Ben (Solutions Eng): FYI — I'll attach the sample logs and rotation screenshot in the ticket once ready.

Carmen (Sales): perfect — closing loop here. will update channel when I have S3 creds and questions.
